### Dawn.Common
A utilities library providing commonly used code for cross-platform and platform-specific functionality across projects of mine.

> [!NOTE]
> The repo is meant for internal consumption of applications of mine.
> APIs may break or considerably change across versions, you have been warned!
> It's up to the implementer to adjust to breaking changes. In most cases this would be myself.

### Installation
Install via the .NET SDK

```bash
# Core Utils
dotnet add package Dawn.Common

# Windows specific Utils
dotnet add package Dawn.Common.Windows

# Windows specific Desktop Utils
dotnet add package Dawn.Common.Windows.Desktop
```
